chunks: And Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:

I read in the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام: 'If a man marries a woman and then commits zina before consummating the marriage, she is not lawful for him, because he is a fornicator; they are to be separated, and he gives her half of the dowry.'

key_terms.لَمْ تَحِلَّ لَهُ: she did not remain lawful for him
key_terms.نِصْفَ الْمَهْرِ: half of the dowry due to the wife
key_terms.يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا: the two are to be separated

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man commits zina after marriage but before consummation?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from the Book of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning marriage and zina. It states that if a husband commits zina before consummation, separation takes place between the spouses and the woman is entitled to half of the mahr.
